author: ETA PRIME
description:
Testing the OneXFly Apex in dock mode at 80W with the Ryzen AI Max+ 395 to see how far this handheld can really go. Synthetic benchmarks, real 1440p gaming, temps, and the tuning trick that boosted performance.

https://onexplayerstore.com/products/onexfly-apex-worlds-most-powerful-8-gaming-handheld?srsltid=AfmBOorLcSLCHJ5U7aqEXtrVIcY4WFCAWjMyqWJmpsRL7JIRcDqMh07R&variant=51844368367910

In this video I push the OneXFly Apex (Ryzen AI Max+ 395, 128GB unified memory) beyond typical handheld settings by running 80W TDP on wall power. I compare OneXConsole’s 80W preset to a custom profile using Universal x86 Tuning Utility, showing higher CPU boost behavior and a big jump in CPU scores. Then it’s onto GPU testing with Geekbench OpenCL and 3DMark Time Spy, followed by real-world gaming at 1440p High with FSR Balanced where needed.
